pages.title: Battleships Can Launch Aircraft; Carriers Can Mount Spinal Guns
pages.text: Electromagnetic Rails can accelerate entire subspaces through the Electromagnetic Rail Accelerator, a special type of "weapon." An accelerator installed on subspace A can use a rail installed on subspace B to launch and accelerate subspace A. The following pages explain how to use this system.

1. Construct a valid Electromagnetic Rail; see $(l:vsie:peripheral/electro_magnet_rail)Electromagnetic Rail/$.$(br2)2. On a different subspace, install an Electromagnetic Rail Accelerator and assign it a weapon channel. A dedicated channel is recommended.$(br2)3. When the Control Seat fires the accelerator, any subspace within a spherical area around the rail core, with radius equal to the rail's length, receives continuous thrust along the rail. The force is proportional to the accelerated subspace's mass. The rail's own subspace receives an equal and opposite reaction force.

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: 1. While accelerating, the system draws (accelerated subspace mass / kpg * 1000) FE per second from the subspace carrying the rail. Make sure it stores enough energy to complete the launch.$(br2)2. Electromagnetic rail acceleration disables reverse force damping.$(br2)3. AeroIE accepts no responsibility for lost subspaces, server crashes, JiuHu stranded 420,000 blocks away, or irreversible world corruption caused by launching a large ship from a small one or building a bearing-powered perpetual catapult.
